name: WOKING 600 SPIDER

specs.notes: McLaren's 600LT (Spider here): the 3.8 twin-turbo V8 at 600 PS and 620 N m behind the seats, a seven-speed dual clutch, ~1,300 kg, a 2,670 mm wheelbase. Its torque curve, ratios and aero are estimates.

garage.blurb: A longtail McLaren with the roof off: light, loud and sharp, with exhausts that spit flames straight up out of the deck.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel cut out to turn (tools/cars/mc600lt.json), the eye placed by hand from section views; an automatic or dual clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
